
══════════════════════════════════════════
  HUNT: Process Hollowing
══════════════════════════════════════════

  VERDICT     LIKELY HOLLOWING — MEM_PRIVATE at image base correlated with RWX protection
  Confidence  medium
  Score       1/2  (requires MEM_PRIVATE at the image base correlated with a second structural anomaly; single signals are leads only)
  Coverage    COMPLETE
  Review      high

  KEY SIGNALS

  Correlated structural hollowing indicators  [MEDIUM]  DETECTION  (hollowing.structural_correlation)
    Inference   : 2 independent structural signal(s) correlate at the same image base: MEM_PRIVATE
                  at image base, RWX protection.
    Confidence  : medium — Any one of these signals alone has a plausible benign explanation (manual
                  mapping, a capture-time read race, a JIT/packer using RWX). MEM_PRIVATE at the
                  image base correlated with a missing/wiped MZ header AND/OR RWX protection at that
                  same address is materially harder to explain away — the combination the module's
                  own checks were designed to catch.
    Facts:
      - VA=0x0000000140000000 corroborators=2 MEM_PRIVATE at image base; RWX protection
    Limitations:
      - Structural correlation is strong evidence but not a substitute for live-execution
        corroboration (no thread-context signal is available for this hunter).

  MEM_PRIVATE memory at the image base  [MEDIUM]  LEAD  (hollowing.mem_private_at_image_base)
    Inference   : The main module's image base is backed by MEM_PRIVATE memory, not a file-mapped
                  MEM_IMAGE region.
    Confidence  : medium — A genuine PE image loaded normally is always MEM_IMAGE at its base —
                  MEM_PRIVATE there means nothing was actually mapped from the executable file this
                  process is supposed to be running. Structural on its own, but a manually-mapped,
                  otherwise benign loader (some DRM/anti-cheat/packer stubs) can also produce this
                  without hollowing — correlated with a second anomaly below before it counts toward
                  the score.
    Facts:
      - VA=0x0000000140000000 File_offset=(not captured) size=0x5000 state=MEM_COMMIT
        type=MEM_PRIVATE protect=PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE
    Limitations:
      - A manual-mapping loader that isn't hollowing can also produce this signal alone.

  RWX protection at the image base  [LOW]  LEAD  (hollowing.rwx_at_image_base)
    Inference   : The main module's image base carries RWX-family protection.
    Confidence  : low — RWX at the image base is needed to write replacement code during hollowing,
                  but RWX alone is routinely used by JITs, debuggers, and some legitimate packers —
                  a lead, not proof, on its own.
    Facts:
      - VA=0x0000000140000000 File_offset=(not captured) protect=PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE
        type=MEM_PRIVATE
    Limitations:
      - Does not by itself distinguish hollowing from JIT/legitimate self-modifying-code use cases
        at this address.

  IMAGE BASE

      PEB ImagePath: C:\Windows\System32\legit.exe
      ImageBase: VA 0x0000000140000000 File offset (not captured)
      Memory: MEM_PRIVATE PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE MEM_COMMIT (region VA 0x0000000140000000 size
      0x5000, File offset (not captured))
      MZ header: MZ present (first bytes 4d5a909090909090, 64 byte(s) read)
      Module list: both report 'legit.exe'
